---
name: Safety report
about: A wrong contraindication, a missing notice, misleading wording or a medical-content error
title: "safety: "
labels: safety
---

> **Do not include personal health information.** This issue is public. If it is also a security problem, use the private route in SECURITY.md instead.

**Item** — the id or name of the pattern, formula, herb, red flag, rule or notice (for example `F_GUIZHI`, `R_PREG_HERB_CAUTION`, `N-PREG`), or the screen and the sentence.

**What is wrong, and why** — with a source if you have one.

**Who could be harmed, and how** — population, medication class, condition.

**Steps to see it** — made-up answers only: profile (age band, sex, pregnancy, medication classes), the answers that matter, and what the result showed.

**Versions** — from *Settings → Versions*: app build, knowledge base, engine, profile (release or dev).

**Suggested severity** (see the safety policy §8): S1 harmful content shipped · S2 safety-relevant defect · S3 wording or claim · S4 other.
